architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Router use React Router. State use Zustand. Styling use Tailwind CSS. API calls use Axios. Auth use JWT in HTTP-only cookie. Design tokens extracted from Stitch screens into src/styles/tokens.css.

tickets.title: Splash screen page (src/pages/Splash.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch splash screen to React. Extract brand logo, background color, animation timing. Match pixel-perfect. No auth check. Auto-redirect to dashboard after 2s if token exist, else to login.
acceptance_criteria: Logo SVG inline or import from src/assets/

tickets.title: Dashboard home page (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch dashboard. Extract: top bar, greeting card, quick actions, recent orders, upcoming exams. Use Zustand store for user data. Fetch data on mount. Error boundary wrap API calls.

tickets.title: Product detail page (src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch product detail. Extract: product image carousel, title, price, description, variant selector, add-to-cart button. Use URL param for product ID. Fetch product data on mount. Variant change update price.

tickets.title: Order review page (src/pages/OrderReview.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch order review. Extract: order summary, recipient info, shipping method, payment method, item list, total calculation. Use Zustand cart store. Form validation for recipient fields. Submit order dispatch API call.

tickets.title: Registration page (src/pages/Register.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch registration. Extract: form fields (name, email, phone, password, confirm password), submit button, validation errors. Password strength meter. API call on submit. Redirect to dashboard on success.

tickets.title: Exam calendar page (src/pages/ExamCalendar.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch exam calendar. Extract: month view, day cells, exam events, event detail modal. Use URL param for month/year. Fetch exams on mount. Click event open modal with exam details.

tickets.title: Shared components and design tokens (src/components/, src/styles/)
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from Stitch screens: buttons, cards, modals, form inputs, headers, footers. Extract design tokens: colors, spacing, typography, shadows. Tailwind config extend tokens. Components use tokens via Tailwind classes.
acceptance_criteria: Components use tokens via Tailwind classes

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Extract navigation bar from Stitch screens. Router use React Router. Routes: splash, login, register, dashboard, product detail, order review, exam calendar, 404. Auth middleware protect routes. Layout component wrap pages. Error boundary top-level.
